Sources of the c_Circus group (carto, games, others (myAstro moved to cloud-me-profiles, #1218); movies, music, myfeed moved to cloud-webapps-2 c_Suite, #1204; front-circus renamed CG-circus), split from diegonmarcos/front-projects (#1072, which itself was split from diegonmarcos.github.io). Paths mirror the original layout (c_Circus/... at the repo root). The Pages workflow of diegonmarcos.github.io checks this repo out over its workspace and publishes it. History stays in diegonmarcos.github.io (snapshot copy). SPLIT-PATHS.txt lists the overlaid paths.

a-Lfy_CG-Zirkus/ (music projects, moved with history from Projects-labtools, #1259) is now laid out as master folders (#1280), display names in each README:

  • Music-Production/ ("MUSIC PRODUCTION"): Music-DAW/ ("Music - DAW", LMMS app), Music-Mixer/ ("Music -Mixer", Mixxx app)
  • Video-Production/ ("VIDEO PRODUCTION"): Higgsfield/ ("Higgsfield", AI video platform)
  • Game-Production/ ("GAME PRODUCTION"): Unity/, Godot/, GDevelop/

The web mini-games in c_Circus/games are not engine projects and stay in place.
